name: Twinvoid Palm
description: Strike with a palm that opens a small void on contact and a second void a breath after.

name: Voidpair Guard
description: Cross two voids before the body so a blow meets nothing twice.

name: Voidpair Sense
description: Feel the space between the two voids and know what has crossed it.

name: Nullpair Jab
description: Jab two fingers that each carry a hollow so that the point of impact is emptied twice.

name: Voidpair Lock
description: Hold one void on each arm of an opponent and seal the qi in both.

name: Twinvoid Purge
description: Draw a poison into one void and a curse into the other and let both vanish.

name: Twinvoid Ripple
description: Send ripples of unmaking out from both voids that weaken all they cross.

name: Voidpair Annul
description: Meet a great technique between the two voids and annul it as it passes.

name: Twinvoid Crush
description: Close the two voids on each other and crush all that stands between them into the gap.

name: Twinvoid Erasure
description: Join the two voids at the target and erase it from within with a stroke no ward can turn.

name: Stilled Current
description: Still the current of qi in the limb of an opponent so it runs thin.

name: Ripple Sense
description: Read the ripples where a current has been drained to find who drained it.

name: Currentless Step
description: Step into the dry bed of a drained current and cross the gap without effort.

name: Dry Strike
description: Strike a drained limb with a hand that carries no moisture of qi at all.

name: Null Eddy
description: Spin a small empty eddy before the body that turns a blow round and past.

name: Draining Eddy
description: Hold an eddy on an opponent and draw the qi round and out of the body.

name: Absence Purge
description: Drain taint and curse residue from an ally down the empty bed of a current.

name: Parting Void
description: Part the guard of an opponent with a wedge of nothing and strike through the gap.

name: Void Undertow
description: Open a draining undertow beneath the foe that drags balance and strength into the gap.

name: Current Annul
description: Dry up an incoming flood of qi before it can reach the user or the allies behind.

name: Tideless Void
description: Drain the whole tide of qi from a foe and seal the empty bed so that it cannot fill again.

name: Unseen Swoop
description: Drop from a height with the body emptied of sign so the foe sees nothing fall.

name: Talon Null
description: Rake with a hooked hand that leaves a track of numb flesh.

name: Hawkgap Sense
description: Pick out from far above the one gap in a crowd's qi that marks a hidden caster.

name: Voidhawk Stoop
description: Stoop on a target without a sound and land the blow before the senses react.

name: Voidwing Glide
description: Glide on spread wings of nothing across open air in near silence.

name: Eyeless Dive
description: Dive through the field of sight so the opponent loses the user in a blank.

name: Hawkvoid Plunge
description: Plunge from the sky with a void for a talon and strike the one chosen.

name: Voidhawk Seal
description: Seal the qi of a prey in a single close of the void talon.

name: Voidhawk Phase
description: Turn into nothing for an instant and pass through the guard and the body of the target to the far side.

name: Windward Hush
description: Hush the gale before the user so that it carries no force.

name: Silent Gust
description: Loose a gust of nothing that hits without a sound or a stir of air.

name: Voidhush Step
description: Cross the windward ground in a step that raises neither dust nor breath.

name: Calm Ward
description: Hold a pocket of dead calm round the body in the teeth of a storm.

name: Voidgale Quiet
description: Quiet every sound and spark in a wide space until the gale has nothing to carry.

name: Stillwind Purge
description: Still the wind round an ally and lift foul air and taint out with it.

name: Unwind Strike
description: Strike through the lull in a gust where no force can be spared to answer.

name: Windless Hush
description: Cast a total hush across the field until no wind and no technique moves.

name: Silence Rend
description: Rend the air with a sudden silence that tears at the body of everything in it.

name: Windless Void
description: Draw the whole force of a storm or a blast into the void and leave the air dead still.

name: Anchor Hush
description: Sink a hush into the ground as an anchor so that sworn ground stays still.

name: Oathnull Palm
description: Strike with a sworn palm that unmakes the qi at the point of contact.

name: Anchorgap Sense
description: Tie the senses to the anchor and read any gap that opens near it.

name: Voidanchor Guard
description: Hold the anchor before the body so that a blow can find no purchase.

name: Voidvow Step
description: Step from one anchored point to the next in a blink.

name: Voidanchor Seal
description: Anchor the qi of a foe to a single point and keep it sealed there.

name: Oathnull Purge
description: Anchor a curse in the void and drop it away from an ally.

name: Voidanchor Drain
description: Drain the strength of an oath-breaker into the anchor as long as it stands.

name: Vowed Erasure
description: Strike a foe with a sworn palm that cancels the foe's last defence.

name: Voidanchor Annul
description: Anchor a great technique in the void and annul it in place.

name: Oathbound Silence
description: Bind the oath-breaker in a total sworn silence that stops all technique.

name: Voidanchor Verdict
description: Judge the oath-breaker and erase the foe's strength with a stroke that no ward can turn.

name: Emptiness Spill
description: Spill a sheet of emptiness over the ground that weakens those who stand in it.

name: Nothing Guard
description: Spread a wide guard of nothing that takes blows from the front and the flank.

name: Unwalled Sense
description: Let the senses run out through the emptiness as far as it extends.

name: Spreading Void
description: Let a void spread across the field and drag the strength of all within it.

name: Emptiness Purge
description: Pour the emptiness over allies to empty out poison and taint.

name: Boundless Drain
description: Drain strength from every foe in the open at an even steady rate.

name: Vast Hush
description: Lay a vast hush over the field and silence every technique below a great force.

name: Emptiness Collapse
description: Collapse the emptiness inward and pull the ground and foes toward its centre.

name: Voidwide Absorb
description: Open the whole emptiness to drink in blasts and strikes alike until none remain.
